sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Daisy Flower Pearl Pendant Necklace - Anti-Tarnish Gold Jewelry
sourceNotes.rawContent:
- A perfect blend of nature and elegance, this daisy flower pendant necklace features a lustrous pearl at its center, surrounded by beautifully detailed petals. Crafted from durable anti-tarnish stainless steel and plated in 18K gold, it's a versatile piece that adds a fresh, feminine touch to any outfit.
-
- Premium Quality | Anti-Tarnish
- Base Material: Stainless Steel
- Plating: 18K Gold-Plated
- Shape: Daisy Flower with Pearl
- Size: One-size & Adjustable
- Net Quantity: 1
- Designed to complement both casual and formal outfits effortlessly
- Care Tips:
-
- Wipe with a soft cloth after every use
- Avoid contact with harsh chemicals, sprays, and perfumes
- Store in a flat box to prevent scratches
- Do not soak in water
- Keywords: gold necklace, daisy necklace, flower pendant, pearl necklace, anti-tarnish jewelry, stainless steel, elegant necklace, feminine jewelry, gift for her, 18k gold plated, floral jewelry
